dct_description_sm: The primary objective of this study was to measure the net atmospheric exchange of carbon dioxide (CO2) and methane (CH4) with common high Arctic freshwater ecosystems and to place these findings in context with similar terrestrial studies from the same high Arctic location. Using these sources together, we aimed to delineate a clearer watershed-scale understanding of high Arctic exchange of CO2 and CH4.
dct_title_s: The importance of freshwater systems to the net atmospheric exchange of carbon dioxide and methane with a rapidly changing high Arctic watershed (Lake Hazen, Quttinirpaaq National Park, Nunavut, Canada)
